name: Corrosive Aura
body:
Discipline: psychometabolism [Acid]; Level: psychic warrior 1, egoist 1

MANIFESTING

Display: material, visual
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: 5 ft.
Area: All squares adjacent to you
Duration: 1 round/lvl. (D)
Saving Throw: Reflex half; Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 1

DESCRIPTION

You surround yourself with a corrosive aura, damaging all who come near. Each creature that ends its turn in your square or adjacent to you takes 1d6 points of acid damage.

Augment: For every additional power point spent, the damage increases by 1d6. For every two additional dice of damage, the save DC increases by 1.
